comment: Tool bindings are deliberately asymmetric BEFORE transformation and must be
identical AFTER it. The reference lane is fed the OpenCode-native logical
name so the shipped plugin genuinely performs its rename; the candidate lane
is fed the Claude-native wire name so its decorator performs no rename at
all. wireName is asserted, never derived.
Schemas are authored JSON Schema literals. They are passed straight to
bindTools as Anthropic-native tool objects so no Zod-to-JSON-Schema
